workflow.requirement: Create a new URL-shortening REST API with create, redirect and click analytics endpoints, backed by SQLite, as a standalone new project.
workflow.normalizedRequirement: Develop a stand-alone URL-shortening REST API service utilizing SQLite for data persistence. The system must support three primary functionalities: creating shortened URLs, redirecting shortened URLs to their original destinations, and providing click analytics for each shortened URL.

operations: GET / returned the JSON service index
GET /swagger returned HTTP 200 with the interactive UI
GET /swagger/v1/swagger.json returned OpenAPI 3.0.1 with the expected paths
GET /{code} returned HTTP 302 with Location set to the original URL
